title: The 4 Best Milk Frothers for Matcha
h1: The 4 Best Milk Frothers for Matcha
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for milk frothers for matcha, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at milk frothers for matcha using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Zulay Original Milk Frother
products.blurb: Key specs: Fast handheld whisk motor, Narrow whisk head fits small mugs and bowls, Battery-powered, no cord or jug.
strengths: Narrow whisk head dissolves matcha powder into a smooth paste faster than a wide countertop jug allows
Works directly in whatever bowl or mug the matcha is being prepared in
Portable enough to use for matcha at a desk or while traveling
limitations: Doesn't heat water or milk, so the water for the matcha paste needs separate warming
Requires holding the whisk at an angle to fully reach clumped powder at the bottom of a narrow cup
Battery-powered motor is less consistent in speed than a mains-powered unit over long sessions
features: Narrow whisk head fits small mugs and bowls

products.name: Nespresso Aeroccino4
products.blurb: Key specs: 4 modes including cold froth, Induction heating for the milk portion, Non-stick jug.
strengths: Handles the milk-frothing half of a matcha latte well, leaving the matcha whisking to a separate small bowl step
Cold froth mode works for iced matcha lattes, an increasingly common order
Consistent foam texture pairs well with a pre-made matcha paste poured in afterward
limitations: Not suited to whisking the matcha powder itself, the jug is too wide and deep for a small amount of powder and water
Fixed hot setting can run hotter than ideal if matcha paste is added directly instead of premixed separately
Best used as a two-step process alongside a separate matcha whisk
features: Induction heating for the milk portion

products.name: PowerLix Handheld Milk Frother with Stand
strengths: Works with hot or cold drinks
limitations: Foam is less fine than a jug frother

products.name: Maestri House LunaFro 2.0 Rechargeable Milk Frother
strengths: Good for matcha and protein shakes
limitations: Less fine foam than a jug

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
